title: Rabbids Invasion
description:
S1 E27 — Flight of the Rabbids
Two Rabbids mistakenly believe that their boss has transformed into a balloon; they pursue a child with a balloon, attempting to rescue their supposed boss.

title: Rabbids Invasion
description:
S1 E46 — Holy Rabbid-Cow!
In the country, a fly fascinates two Rabbids; after unintentionally crushing it in an empty can, they decide to go and catch some of the ones flying around a cow.

title: Rabbids Invasion
description:
S1 E49 — Hypno Rabbid
The Chief Rabbid invents new tasks for the Rabbids; finding a disk with a spiral on it, he makes his troops fan him by making it spin, but ends up hypnotized; the other Rabbids take advantage of this and reverse roles.

title: The Adventures of Super Mario Bros. 3
description:
S1 — Up, Up and a Koopa
The Mushroom Kingdom is sent into the sky.

title: The Adventures of Super Mario Bros. 3
description:
S1 E9 — Mush-Rumors; The Ugly Mermaid
Humans are lost in the Mushroom Kingdom; the brothers enter an underwater kingdom.

title: The Adventures of Super Mario Bros. 3
description:
S1 E12 — True Colors; Recycled Koopa
King Koopa tricks the Mushroom people; junk is dumped into the Mushroom Kingdom.

title: The Legend of Zelda
description:
S1 E13 — The Moblins Are Revolting
Ganon demonstrates a new wand that makes a bubble around its victim that can only be popped by the Triforce of Power; fed up with Ganon's orders, a Moblin uses the wand to trap Ganon in a bubble and throws him down a bottomless pit.

title: The Legend of Zelda
description:
S1 E2 — Cold Spells
The first days of spring mark spring-cleaning at Hyrule Castle; Link fakes a cold to avoid chores; Ganon infiltrates the castle and, to create a distraction, covertly augments Sprite's magical powers as she too performs cleaning chores.

title: Pac-Man and the Ghostly Adventures
description:
S1 E26 — Invasion of the Pointy Heads
Apex strikes a deal with the Netherworld to join forces.

title: Pac-Man and the Ghostly Adventures
description:
S2 E1 — Ride the Wild Pac-topus
Dr. Buttocks tries to steal Pac's golden key; he uses a mind control chip that overpowers carnival attractions.

title: Pac-Man and the Ghostly Adventures
description:
S2 E2 — Meanie Genie
Pac is tricked into finding a bottle holding a genie, who promises to grant his every wish.

title: He-Man and the Masters of the Universe
description:
S1 E25 — The Council of Evil: Part 1
After the Masters capture Skeletor's warriors, Eternia relaxes their security unaware of Skeletor's true plan.

title: He-Man and the Masters of the Universe
description:
S1 E26 — The Council of Evil: Part 2
He-Man and Battle Cat are overpowered by Skeletor's newly formed Council of Evil, but manage to escape capture by transforming back into their other selves.

title: He-Man and the Masters of the Universe
description:
S2 E1 — The Last Stand
Zodak comes to the rescue of the Sorceress and builds a force field around Castle Grayskull; Orko hands Prince Adam his Power Sword to keep Skeletor at bay.

title: Angry Birds
description:
S3 E11 — Last Tree Standing
Red and his fearless bird friends must find a way to protect their precious eggs from the Bad Piggies and their relentless assault.

title: Angry Birds
description:
S3 E15 — King Of The Ring
Red and his fearless bird friends must find a way to protect their precious eggs from the Bad Piggies and their relentless assault.

title: Talking Tom and Friends
description:
S1 E26 — The Perfect Day
Ben's simulator app makes Tom's fantasies come true; he realizes only Angela can perfect his day.

title: Talking Tom and Friends
description:
S1 E28 — Ghost Pirate Hunting
Hank and Ginger touch Ben's computer without permission; a scary pirate ghost appears.

title: Rabbids Invasion
description:
S1 E53 — Rabbid Race to the Moon
Two scientists put some Rabbids to the test to see if they have the right stuff for a trip to the moon.

title: Rabbids Invasion
description:
S1 E56 — Rabbid Doggies
A Rabbid discovers that a ball seems to attract a dog from the park; maybe the ball will allow him to control the dog?

title: The Adventures of Super Mario Bros. 3
description:
S1 E13 — The Venice Menace; Super Koopa
Venice is under siege; Kooky Von Koopa makes a magic pendant.

title: The Adventures of Super Mario Bros. 3
description:
S1 — Sneaky Lying Cheating Giant Ninja Koopas
Ninja Koopas try to turn a prince into a dog.

title: The Legend of Zelda
description:
S1 E3 — The White Knight
After Link and Zelda are ambushed by monsters, a prince from a neighboring kingdom saves the day, then sweeps the princess off her feet.

title: The Legend of Zelda
description:
S1 E5 — Sing for the Unicorn
Link plans an attempt at romancing Zelda by swinging into her window from above by a rope; the attempt is interrupted as Ganon rides a flying unicorn over the castle and kidnaps the king for ransom.
